environments.name: GSM8K
environments.summary: Eight thousand grade-school maths word problems, each with a worked solution and a single numeric answer.
environments.reward_description: The final number is compared with the reference answer. No model judges the result.
requirements: Pin the dataset revision used for the train and test splits
Keep held-out problems out of the training split
Record the decoding settings used for both scores

launch.note: The change was measured by running this example. Training moves the score because the model writes out its working, so its attempts differ enough to learn from.

examples.name: GSM8K, trained
examples.summary: Score 64 grade-school word problems, train a LoRA adapter with GRPO, then score the same 64 again.
examples.command: export NODUS_RL_EXAMPLE_BASE=https://api.nodus-compute.ai/v1/artifacts/rl-example && python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages transformers accelerate trl peft datasets && python3 -c "import os,urllib.request as u;[u.urlretrieve(os.environ['NODUS_RL_EXAMPLE_BASE']+'/'+n,n) for n in ('nodus_rl_events.py','gsm8k_trainer.py')]" && python3 gsm8k_trainer.py --model Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B --train-tasks 512 --heldout-tasks 64 --steps 150 --seed 42 --output outputs/results.json
